svg.text: Grey: foundation model behavior, no enforcement. Scarlet: the same model behind the Benchmark PDP. Same bank, same grader; only the model changes between pairs.

text.font-family: Charter, 'Charter BT', 'Bitstream Charter', 'Charis SIL', ui-serif, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Allowed cases cannot leak by construction, so the exfiltration ceiling is half the bank. Refusal (no enforcement / behind PDP) is never containment.

text.font-family: Charter, 'Charter BT', 'Bitstream Charter', 'Charis SIL', ui-serif, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Development-bank measurements, primary pass per model, integrity status Ineligible. Not a publishable model claim.
